1. Heard Shri Piyush Pathak, learned Counsel for the petitioners and learned AGA for the State.
2. This petition seeks issuance of direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the opposite parties no. 2 to 4 not to harass the petitioners in the name of search in Case Crime No. 0156 of 2022, under Sections 366, 328, 376, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Ibrabhimpur, district Ambedkar Nagar.
3.

Learned A.G.A., on the basis of instructions 27.10.2025 received from Sub-Inspector, Police Station Ibrahimpur, district Ambedkar Nagar, submits that after investigation, charge-sheet No. 171 of 2022 dated 16.09.2022 has been forwarded to the Court concerned against accused Vineet Tiwari,
in which the Additional Sessions Judge-I (POCSO Act), Ambedkar Nagar, vide order dated 12.04.2024, acquitted accused Vineet Tiwari.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-I (POCSO Act), Ambedkar Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereafter, charge-sheet No. 171-A has been forwarded to the Court concerned on 01.06.2024 and the same has been submitted to the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambedkar Nagar on 23.08.2024 and the next date has been fixed for 06.11.2025.

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambedkar Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thus, the petition has lost its efficacy.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioners does not dispute the above and submits that the petition has become infructuous.
